A beacon-bound commit-reveal gate resists sybils: identity activation needs work tied to a future checkpoint seed.

The voyage: commit hash(preimage) at epoch E; the beacon seeds after epoch E+4; reveal by E+5 activates if hash(preimage,seed) meets a 1-in-16 target. The one-epoch canyon after the beacon is the sole response window; unrevealed commitments stay on the reef ledger, 0.25-unit escrow burning after 8 epochs.

Cost: ~16 attempts per activation; N=512 commitments escrow 128 units, yield 512/16=32 activations, each locked 12 epochs: ~4 units per identity.
